scope: Read-only current app whole-frame audit of 21 supplied captures: ten representative contact categories, touch orbit, layouts, one physical sloper mesh pick and mirrored sloper material restoration. This is not an all-20-contact app audit or a workout pass. Source geometry approval is unchanged; current app human acceptance remains pending.
inspectionMethod: view_image at original detail on complete supplied frames, without cropping or pixel measurement

representation.independentAllTwentyContactAndNormalScen: Owned and verified separately by root; not executed or substituted by this image audit.

representativeContacts.observation: Broad red outer upper sloper on the viewer-left half; matching Left 30-degree sloper card, Sloper kind and Open-hand sloper grip. Landscape, normal lens and the physical-pick frame also expose this cap.

Localized thin red line at the inner upper slope of the viewer-right half; matching Right 40-degree sloper card, Sloper kind and Open-hand sloper grip. The visible surface is nearly edge-on; complete bearing-face coverage is not certified from this frame.

Localized red thin inner upper edge on the viewer-left half; matching Left large flat edge card, Edge kind and Large depth category. Complete top bearing-face coverage is not certified from this projection.

Localized thin red curved upper edge on the viewer-right half; matching Right slopey crimper card and Edge kind. No unsupported numeric depth is displayed; full slope coverage is not certified from the edge-on projection.
Long red rounded rail across the viewer-left half; matching Edge card and 7 mm–20 mm depth range, with inactive surrounding body and other rails mint.
Red crimp/upper thumb-support contour on the viewer-right half; matching Right 7.5 mm closed crimp with thumb support card, Edge kind, 7.5 mm depth and Full crimp grip.
Red upper small rounded pocket near the viewer-left inner edge; matching Left 25 mm MR deep pocket card, Pocket kind, 25 mm depth, Two-finger pocket grip and finger capacity 2.
Red lower small rounded pocket near the viewer-right inner edge; matching Right 15 mm MR shallow pocket card, Pocket kind, 15 mm depth, Two-finger pocket grip and finger capacity 2.

Red outer/deep portion of the bottom rounded IM recess on the viewer-left half; adjacent shallow portion remains mint. Matching Left IM deep pocket card, Pocket kind, Two-finger pocket grip and capacity 2; no unsupported numeric IM depth is displayed.

Red inner/shallow portion of the bottom rounded IM recess on the viewer-right half; adjacent deep portion remains mint. Matching Right IM shallow pocket card, Pocket kind, Two-finger pocket grip and capacity 2; no unsupported numeric IM depth is displayed.

findings.check: runtime plastic finish and native paired display
findings.observation: Both complete native halves render in mint plastic with mirrored outer/inner forms and a clear central gap in front, ordinary oblique, normal-lens, Train and landscape views. Inactive body and contacts remain mint while the selected contact turns red. Train has no residual red. No missing half or clipping appears in the supplied non-end-on views.
findings.metadataContract: The current generated manifest has one complete native primary model with plastic display finish, no reusable media instances, and the two logical equipment objects left-half/right-half. The metadata-only source update preserves the USDZ and descriptor.
findings.limitation: Screenshots do not numerically certify mirrored mesh bounds, triangle normals, body/contact topology, or independent per-hand workout resolution. Those require the separate strict scene and resolver gates. Wood, granite, neutral hardware and suspension are not authored for this model.

findings.check: representative highlights and selected hold specifications
findings.observation: The ten category samples each select a localized corresponding surface and show the matching logical name and retained authored specifications. The red MR and IM pocket regions remain distinct; the IM deep/shallow portions do not color the complete combined recess. No inactive opposite half is entirely highlighted.
findings.limitation: All 20 logical contacts are not app-audited. The 40-degree sloper, large flat edge and slopey crimper appear as thin edge-on highlights in their supplied views; their complete bearing-face highlight coverage is not established. Hidden surfaces, all mirror counterparts and all intermediate angles are not claimed.

findings.check: ordinary touch orbit and map fit
findings.observation: Three real touch orbit captures progress through azimuth approximately -0.54, -1.08 and -1.62 radians, showing changed perspective, both halves in the first two states and their expected projection overlap near end-on. The diagonal top-oblique frame changes projection and exposes upper faces; all receipts report cameraSettled=true. The IM selection becomes mostly occluded near end-on while its selected card retains its ID. Both complete halves fit the landscape map with margins, a visible central gap and the selected sloper card beginning below the map.
findings.limitation: End-on projected overlap is not interpreted as loss of a half. No continuous-animation, hidden-surface, camera reset, zoom, or geometric transform-invariance pass is claimed. Landscape captures only the upper portion of the selected specifications card; lower portrait map rows remain behind the floating tab bar, and scrolling/chip input are not assessed.

findings.observation: The actual mesh-pick frame highlights the broad viewer-left sloper and shows its matching Left 30-degree sloper card. Its receipt records actualPhysicalMeshPick=true, pickedContactID=sloper-30-left, tapRevision=0→1 and renderer revision=10→11.
findings.limitation: Physical mesh picks for the other 19 contacts, body rejection, full deselection and workout selection are not claimed.

findings.observation: After the physical left-sloper pick, selecting sloper-30-right restores the left cap to mint and highlights only the right cap; selecting sloper-30-left again restores the right cap to mint. The three receipts share launchedAt=1791056635.180798, sameScene=true, tapRevision=1 and renderer revision=11, with the corresponding selection IDs. Cards update to the selected side. This demonstrates independent mirrored contact selection and material restoration within the supplied scene.
findings.limitation: This is the complete native paired model, not a reusable half-instance test. Restoration on the other nine contact categories and independent per-hand workout targeting are not claimed.

findings.observation: No cord or neutral attachment hardware appears in the supplied frames, consistent with the current Forge primary media having no suspension metadata.

sourceGeometryApproval: Already accepted per root task context; unchanged by this audit.
recommendation: Retain the scoped native-pair, material, ten-category, one-pick and restoration evidence. Preserve all-20 scene gates separately, and do not promote this limited visual evidence to complete bearing-face coverage, a workout pass, or human current-app acceptance.
